"""Post-hoc raw-endpoint diagnostic: remove local support, keep frequency gains."""

import argparse
import os
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard, read, ref, save


def prepare(root):
    training = read(root / "plan-v1.json")
    guard(training)
    assert (
        read(root / "postprocess-status-v1.json")["status"]
        == "completed-audited-arrays-awaiting-human-native-viewing"
    )
    assert read(root / "native-viewing-v1.json")["figures_represented"] == 50
    point = root / "support-ablation-v1"
    point.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    runner = point / "operator-v1.py"
    shutil.copyfile(__file__, runner)
    collection = read(root / "review-result-v1.json")["collections"]["raw-step1000"]
    export = read(collection["path"])["export"]
    save(
        point / "plan-v1.json",
        {
            "root": str(root),
            "runner": ref(runner),
            "training_plan": ref(root / "plan-v1.json"),
            "design": ref(root / "quality-design-v1.json"),
            "collection": collection,
            "export": export,
            "new_component_forwards": 766,
            "new_parent_DINO_forwards": 0,
            "new_noise_draws": 0,
            "scope": "Post-hoc diagnostic of final raw endpoint on all766 existing cases. Replace only local support with1 after the original forward. Learned frequency gains/weights unchanged. Not a selected checkpoint, fresh validation or new trained model. Compare learned-path replay with its archived prediction; preserve exact same parent and RAW. No target/reference in forward.",
        },
    )


def worker(root):
    import numpy as np
    import torch
    from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash

    from demosaic.cfa import malvar
    from demosaic.late_spectral_detail import LateSpectralDetail
    from demosaic.prediction_archive import fingerprint

    point = root / "support-ablation-v1"
    path = point / "plan-v1.json"
    plan = read(path)
    assert ref(__file__) == plan["runner"]
    for key in ("training_plan", "design", "collection", "export"):
        assert ref(plan[key]["path"]) == plan[key]
    training = read(plan["training_plan"]["path"])
    guard(training)
    assert (
        Path(LateSpectralDetail.forward.__code__.co_filename)
        .resolve()
        .is_relative_to(Path(training["work"]) / "src")
    )
    (point / "worker.claim").open("x").close()
    os.nice(10)
    os.sched_setaffinity(0, sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[2:4])
    torch.set_num_threads(2)
    torch.set_num_interop_threads(1)
    torch.set_float32_matmul_precision("highest")
    torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32 = False
    torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = False
    torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic = True
    torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True)
    torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction(
        12 * 2**30 / torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).total_memory
    )
    state = torch.load(plan["export"]["path"], map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
    assert (
        state["endpoint"] == "model"
        and state["step"] == 1000
        and state["parent"] == training["parent"]
    )
    before_cpu, before_cuda = torch.get_rng_state().clone(), torch.cuda.get_rng_state().clone()
    module = LateSpectralDetail(**state["module_config"]).cuda().eval()
    module.load_state_dict(state["state_dict"], strict=True)
    before = model_hash(module)
    archived = read(plan["collection"]["path"])
    assert archived["module_before"] == before
    by_id = {o["id"]: o for o in archived["observations"]}
    counts = [0]
    module.register_forward_hook(lambda *args: counts.__setitem__(0, counts[0] + 1))
    outputs = []
    predictions = point / "predictions"
    predictions.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    for index, case in enumerate(read(plan["design"]["path"])["observations"]):
        assert (
            psutil.virtual_memory().available > 32 * 2**30
            and shutil.disk_usage(root).free > 96 * 2**30
        )
        assert (
            ref(case["arrays"]["path"]) == case["arrays"]
            and ref(case["parent"]["path"]) == case["parent"]
        )
        arrays = dict(np.load(case["arrays"]["path"]))
        base = torch.from_numpy(np.load(case["parent"]["path"])).cuda()
        batch = {
            k: torch.from_numpy(arrays[k]).cuda() for k in ("packed", "variance", "colors", "wb")
        }
        with torch.inference_mode():
            control, aux = module(base, **batch, return_aux=True)
            proposal = module.synthesis(aux["spectral_delta"], aux["geometry"])
            full = (base + malvar(proposal, batch["colors"], batch["wb"])).cpu().numpy()
        assert full.dtype == np.float32 and np.isfinite(full).all()
        old = by_id[case["id"]]["prediction"]
        assert ref(old["path"]) == old
        cached = np.load(old["path"])
        control = control.cpu().numpy()
        difference = float(np.max(np.abs(control.astype(np.float64) - cached.astype(np.float64))))
        assert difference <= 1e-7, (case["id"], difference)
        dest = predictions / f"prediction-{index:03d}.npy"
        np.save(dest, full)
        outputs.append(
            {
                "id": case["id"],
                "prediction": ref(dest),
                "values": fingerprint(full),
                "archived_control": old,
                "control_bit_exact": bool(np.array_equal(control, cached)),
                "control_maximum_difference_DN16": difference * 65535,
                "learned_support_mean": float(aux["support"].mean()),
                "module_forwards": 1,
            }
        )
        if index % 64 == 0:
            print("full-support cases", index + 1, flush=True)
        del arrays, base, batch, aux, proposal, full, control, cached
    assert counts[0] == 766 and model_hash(module) == before
    assert torch.equal(before_cpu, torch.get_rng_state()) and torch.equal(
        before_cuda, torch.cuda.get_rng_state()
    )
    guard(training)
    save(
        point / "collection-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "completed-posthoc-local-support-ablation",
            "plan": ref(path),
            "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
            "observations": outputs,
            "new_component_forwards": counts[0],
            "new_parent_DINO_forwards": 0,
            "new_noise_draws": 0,
            "module_before": before,
            "module_after": model_hash(module),
            "RNG_unchanged": True,
            "CUDA_peak_allocated_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),
            "scope": plan["scope"],
        },
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=("prepare", "worker"))
    parser.add_argument("root", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    (prepare if args.mode == "prepare" else worker)(args.root.resolve())

"""NumPy scores of the post-hoc local-support intervention, without inference."""

import argparse
from collections import defaultdict
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from score_late_spectral_trial import load_module
from train_directional_bank_trial import read, ref, save


def main(root):
    point = root / "support-ablation-v1"
    collection = read(point / "collection-v1.json")
    plan = read(point / "plan-v1.json")
    assert collection["plan"] == ref(point / "plan-v1.json")
    assert (
        collection["new_component_forwards"] == 766
        and collection["module_before"] == collection["module_after"]
    )
    assert (
        collection["new_parent_DINO_forwards"] == collection["new_noise_draws"] == 0
        and collection["RNG_unchanged"]
    )
    cases = read(plan["design"]["path"])["observations"]
    assert [o["id"] for o in cases] == [o["id"] for o in collection["observations"]]
    metric_path = root.parent / "collaborative-detail-v1/audit-transfer-v1.py"
    metric = load_module(metric_path, "independent_support_ablation_metrics")
    rows = []
    for case, output in zip(cases, collection["observations"], strict=True):
        assert ref(output["prediction"]["path"]) == output["prediction"]
        value = np.load(output["prediction"]["path"])
        assert value.dtype == np.float32 and np.isfinite(value).all()
        assert ref(case["arrays"]["path"]) == case["arrays"]
        a = dict(np.load(case["arrays"]["path"]))
        parent = np.load(case["parent"]["path"]).astype(np.float64)
        change = value.astype(np.float64) - parent
        row = {
            "id": case["id"],
            "kind": case["kind"],
            "cohort": case.get("cohort"),
            "method": "raw-full-local-support",
            "prediction": output["prediction"],
            "correction_RMS_DN16": float(np.sqrt(np.mean(change**2)) * 65535),
        }
        if case["kind"] == "real":
            row["reference_scored"] = False
        elif case["kind"] == "photo":
            row.update(
                variant=case["variant"]["name"],
                **metric.photo_metrics(value, a["target"], a, case["ROI_xywh"]),
            )
        else:
            row.update(metric.errors(value, a["target"], case["ROI_xywh"]))
            if case["kind"] == "mesh":
                signal = metric.detrend(
                    a["target_present"][0].astype(np.float64)
                    - a["target_empty"][0].astype(np.float64)
                )
                empty = a["target_empty"][0].astype(np.float64)
                blank = (
                    np.all(a["target_present"] == a["target_empty"], axis=1)[0]
                    if case["present"]
                    else np.ones((512, 512), bool)
                )
                row.update(
                    present=case["present"],
                    template_gain=float(
                        np.sum(metric.detrend(value[0].astype(np.float64) - empty) * signal)
                        / np.sum(signal**2)
                    ),
                    blank_added_RMS_DN16=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(change[0][:, blank] ** 2)) * 65535)
                    if blank.any()
                    else None,
                )
            else:
                assert case["kind"] == "flat"
                error = value.astype(np.float64) - a["target"].astype(np.float64)
                row.update(
                    noise=case["noise"]["name"],
                    full_spatial_RMS_DN16=float(
                        np.sqrt(np.mean((error - error.mean((-2, -1), keepdims=True)) ** 2)) * 65535
                    ),
                )
        rows.append(row)
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    for row in rows:
        groups[
            row["kind"], row.get("present", row.get("variant", row.get("noise"))), row.get("cohort")
        ].append(row)
    summary = []
    fields = (
        "full_error_RMS_DN16",
        "template_gain",
        "blank_added_RMS_DN16",
        "crop_relative_band_error",
        "crop_linear_sRGB_luma_band_gain",
        "full_spatial_RMS_DN16",
        "correction_RMS_DN16",
    )
    for (kind, condition, cohort), group in groups.items():
        item = {"kind": kind, "condition": condition, "cohort": cohort, "cases": len(group)}
        for field in fields:
            numbers = [r[field] for r in group if r.get(field) is not None]
            if numbers:
                item[field] = float(sum(Decimal(str(v)) for v in numbers) / len(numbers))
        summary.append(item)
    dest = point / "scores-v1.json"
    assert not dest.exists()
    save(
        dest,
        {
            "status": "completed-posthoc-full-support-array-scores",
            "collection": ref(point / "collection-v1.json"),
            "operator": ref(__file__),
            "metric_source": ref(metric_path),
            "rows": rows,
            "summary": summary,
            "control_replays_bit_exact": sum(
                o["control_bit_exact"] for o in collection["observations"]
            ),
            "maximum_control_difference_DN16": max(
                o["control_maximum_difference_DN16"] for o in collection["observations"]
            ),
            "new_forwards_in_scorer": 0,
            "new_noise_draws": 0,
            "scope": plan["scope"],
        },
    )
    for row in summary:
        if row["kind"] in ("mesh", "flat"):
            print(row)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("root", type=Path)
    main(parser.parse_args().root.resolve())

"""Native same-ROI views of the post-hoc local-support intervention."""

import argparse
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
from report_checkpoint_pilot import pixels
from report_late_spectral_mixed_quiet import independent_display
from train_directional_bank_trial import read, ref, save

from demosaic.archive_metrics import noisy_malvar


def main(root):
    point = root / "support-ablation-v1"
    full = {o["id"]: o["prediction"] for o in read(point / "collection-v1.json")["observations"]}
    raw = {
        o["id"]: o["prediction"]
        for o in read(root / "review-v1/raw-step1000/collection-v1.json")["observations"]
    }
    selected = []
    for item in read(root / "figures-v1.json")["images"]:
        if "source_board" in item:
            continue
        case = item["case"]
        keep = case["kind"] == "real"
        keep |= case["kind"] == "mesh" and case["present"] and item["shared_display_contrast"] == 40
        keep |= case["id"] in (
            "flat512-gray-l0.02-iso6400-prior-RGGB",
            "flat512-gray-l0.02-iso12800-prior-RGGB",
            "organic-02a76fd33b5e1414a0504f0b3f0aeb03a569b6f4-photo-faint-RGGB",
            "photo-3e638bbb56ed80abc88939468783e3bf9b92ee77-photo-dark-RGGB",
        )
        if keep:
            selected.append(item)
    assert len(selected) == 14
    out = point / "figures-v1"
    out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    font = ImageFont.truetype("/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf", 10)
    images = []
    channels = 0
    for index, item in enumerate(selected):
        case = item["case"]
        a = dict(np.load(case["arrays"]["path"]))
        roi = item["ROI_xywh"]
        labels = ["Noisy Malvar", "V143 parent", "V147 learned support", "V147 full support"]
        sources = [
            noisy_malvar(a),
            np.load(case["parent"]["path"]),
            np.load(raw[case["id"]]["path"]),
            np.load(full[case["id"]]["path"]),
        ]
        if case["kind"] == "mesh":
            labels.append("Periodic detail")
            sources.append(np.load(case["periodic_detail"]["path"]))
        labels.append("ISO100 AHD, not GT" if case["kind"] == "real" else "Exact constructed GT")
        target = (
            a["reference_rgb"]
            if "reference_rgb" in a
            else np.load(case["reference_binding"]["path"])
            if case["kind"] == "real"
            else a["target"]
        )
        sources.append(target)
        anchor = np.array(item["shared_camera_RGB_anchor"]).reshape(1, 3, 1, 1)
        contrast, exposure = item["shared_display_contrast"], item["RAW_exposure"]
        cells = []
        for j, source in enumerate(sources):
            selected_roi = (
                [0, 0, 160, 160]
                if case["kind"] == "real"
                and j == len(sources) - 1
                and source.shape[-2:] == (160, 160)
                else roi
            )
            transformed = anchor + contrast * (source.astype(np.float64) - anchor)
            cell = pixels(transformed, a, selected_roi, exposure)
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(
                cell, independent_display(transformed, a, selected_roi, exposure)
            )
            cells.append(cell)
        if case["kind"] == "real" and "cases" in case:
            window = next(w for w in case["cases"] if w["ROI_xywh"] == roi)
            for key, label in (
                ("noisy_camera_jpeg", "ISO6400 JPEG native"),
                ("reference_camera_jpeg", "ISO100 JPEG, not GT"),
            ):
                binding = window["camera_JPEGs"][key]["pixels"]
                assert ref(binding["path"]) == binding
                cells.append(np.load(binding["path"]))
                labels.append(label)
        board = Image.new("RGB", (8 + 168 * len(cells), 212), "#eeeeee")
        draw = ImageDraw.Draw(board)
        draw.text(
            (8, 4),
            f"{case['id']} | local-support diagnostic, RAW contrast{contrast}, exposure{exposure:g}",
            font=font,
            fill="black",
        )
        panels = []
        for j, (label, cell) in enumerate(zip(labels, cells, strict=True)):
            assert cell.shape == (160, 160, 3)
            xywh = [8 + 168 * j, 44, 160, 160]
            board.paste(Image.fromarray(cell), xywh[:2])
            draw.text((xywh[0], 24), label, font=font, fill="black")
            panels.append({"label": label, "xywh": xywh})
            channels += cell.size
        dest = out / f"view-{index:02d}.png"
        board.save(dest)
        actual = np.asarray(Image.open(dest))
        for panel, cell in zip(panels, cells, strict=True):
            x, y, w, h = panel["xywh"]
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual[y : y + h, x : x + w], cell)
        images.append(
            {
                "image": ref(dest),
                "source_board": item["image"],
                "case": case,
                "ROI_xywh": roi,
                "shared_camera_RGB_anchor": anchor.ravel().tolist(),
                "shared_display_contrast": contrast,
                "RAW_exposure": exposure,
                "panels": panels,
                "no_resize": True,
                "full_support_prediction": full[case["id"]],
                "JPEG_display": "native sRGB8" if "cases" in case else None,
            }
        )
    sheets = []
    for start in range(0, len(images), 4):
        subset = images[start : start + 4]
        sheet = Image.new(
            "RGB",
            (max(Image.open(v["image"]["path"]).width for v in subset), 212 * len(subset)),
            "white",
        )
        for j, v in enumerate(subset):
            sheet.paste(Image.open(v["image"]["path"]), (0, j * 212))
        dest = out / f"sheet-{start // 4:02d}.png"
        sheet.save(dest)
        actual = np.asarray(Image.open(dest))
        for j, v in enumerate(subset):
            source = np.asarray(Image.open(v["image"]["path"]))
            h, w, _ = source.shape
            np.testing.assert_array_equal(actual[j * 212 : j * 212 + h, :w], source)
        sheets.append(
            {
                "image": ref(dest),
                "indices": list(range(start, start + len(subset))),
                "no_resize": True,
            }
        )
    save(
        point / "figures-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "rendered-and-independently-pixel-checked",
            "collection": ref(point / "collection-v1.json"),
            "renderer": ref(__file__),
            "images": images,
            "sheets": sheets,
            "RGB_channels_checked": channels,
            "no_resize": True,
            "new_forwards": 0,
            "new_noise_draws": 0,
            "scope": "Post-hoc diagnostic: same14 source boards/ROIs/transforms as completed review; all real priors/windows, two weak meshes at40x diagnostic contrast, two noisy flats, faint feathers and actual512 dark bird. Real references not GT; JPEGs native. Full support changes only the spatial gate, same raw weights.",
        },
    )
    print("Rendered14 ablation figures /4 sheets; checked RGB channels", channels)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("root", type=Path)
    main(parser.parse_args().root.resolve())

"""Audit the completed late-spectral source trace, states and endpoint exports."""

import argparse
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

import torch
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard, read, ref, save
from train_v43_quality_trial import live


def main(root):
    plan = read(root / "plan-v1.json")
    guard(plan)
    result = read(root / "train-result-v1.json")
    smoke = read(root / "smoke-result-v1.json")
    assert result["plan"] == ref(root / "plan-v1.json")
    assert not live(result["owner"]) and not live(smoke["owner"])
    assert result["steps"] == 1000 and result["counts"] == {
        "parent_root": 990,
        "DINO": 990,
        "module_training": 1000,
        "optimizer_updates": 1000,
        "adopted_parent_batches": 10,
    }
    assert result["parent_model_before"] == result["parent_model_after"]
    assert (
        result["DINO_before"]
        == result["DINO_after"]
        == "691963f0f796aac860d818d59d9d14287a4675612829fbe9467c7f5df8ce5b14"
    )
    assert result["parent_all_gradients_absent"] and result["initial_output_exact_parent"]
    assert (
        len(result["parameter_maximum_gradients"]) == 12
        and min(result["parameter_maximum_gradients"].values()) > 0
    )
    states = {}
    for step in (250, 500, 750, 1000):
        path = root / f"checkpoints/train-step{step:04d}.pt"
        s = torch.load(path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
        assert s["step"] == step and s["horizon"] == 1000 and s["parent"] == plan["parent"]
        assert s["module_config"] == {"max_window": 256}
        assert len(s["model"]) == len(s["ema"]) == len(s["optimizer"]["state"]) == 12
        assert sum(v.numel() for v in s["model"].values()) == 30402
        assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for key in ("model", "ema") for v in s[key].values())
        assert all(
            float(v["step"]) == step and all(torch.isfinite(t).all() for t in v.values())
            for v in s["optimizer"]["state"].values()
        )
        assert s["counts"]["optimizer_updates"] == s["counts"]["module_training"] == step
        assert s["counts"]["parent_root"] == s["counts"]["DINO"] == step - 10
        states[step] = s
    assert all(
        torch.equal(states[250][key], s[key])
        for key in ("torch_CPU_RNG", "torch_CUDA_RNG")
        for s in states.values()
    )
    source = states[1000]["config"]["manifest"]
    rows = [__import__("json").loads(line) for line in Path(source).read_text().splitlines()]
    eligible = {row["id"]: row for row in rows if row["split"] == "train"}
    assert len(eligible) == 90782
    heldout = {
        o["source"]["sha1"]
        for o in read(root / "quality-design-v1.json")["observations"]
        if o["kind"] == "photo"
    }
    assert len(heldout) == 16 and not heldout.intersection(eligible)
    trace = result["trace"]
    assert [r["step"] for r in trace] == list(range(1, 1001))
    domains, photo_ids, mesh_present = Counter(), Counter(), Counter()
    faint = reviewed = 0
    identities = set()
    for row in trace:
        metadata = row["metadata"]
        domain = metadata["domain"]
        domains[domain] += 1
        size = 256 if domain == "photo" else 512
        assert metadata["native_size"] == size and metadata["step"] == row["step"]
        assert row["inputs"]["target"]["shape"] == [4, 3, size, size]
        assert (
            row["inputs"]["packed"]["shape"]
            == row["inputs"]["variance"]["shape"]
            == [4, 4, size // 2, size // 2]
        )
        assert len(metadata["cases"]) == 4 and {c["pattern"] for c in metadata["cases"]} == {
            "RGGB",
            "BGGR",
            "GRBG",
            "GBRG",
        }
        for i, case in enumerate(metadata["cases"]):
            assert (
                case["id"] == f"V147-train-{row['step']:04d}-{i}" and case["id"] not in identities
            )
            identities.add(case["id"])
            record = case["source"]
            assert record["kind"] == domain
            if domain == "photo":
                provenance = record["source"]
                identity = provenance["source_id"]
                assert identity in eligible and identity not in heldout
                assert (
                    min(provenance["cache_xywh"][2:]) >= 512
                    and provenance["augmentation_downsample"] == 2
                )
                assert provenance["draw_index"] == (row["step"] - 1) * 4 + i
                original = eligible[identity]
                assert (
                    original["bin_factor"] == 4
                    and original["cache_sha256"] == provenance["cache_sha256"]
                )
                assert (Path(source).parent / original["cache"]).absolute() == Path(
                    provenance["cache"]
                )
                assert record["contrast"] == 1 or 0.005 <= record["contrast"] <= 0.2
                photo_ids[identity] += 1
                faint += record["contrast"] < 1
                reviewed += provenance["reviewed_roi_xywh"] is not None
            elif domain == "mesh":
                mesh_present[record["recipe"]["present"]] += 1
    assert len(identities) == 4000
    prefix = []
